copying the linked source object's two mode bits to the particle object
target-arrival state transitions and the 40-frame callback delay

notes: The readable reconstruction emits the complete 456-byte owner extent, all calls, branches, registers, memory operations, constants, and literal words. Only the two localized scheduling hunks differ.
The classic exact-only winner reduces the raw residual to seven halfwords without changing either hunk's semantics, but no searched ordinary-C source emits the retained order exactly.
Relocation-aware comparison of the independently assembled retained owner proves all 396 unmasked core bytes identical across the six GS1 editions.

The caller at 0x08095dd0 installs this callback on 24 effect slots and later advances those slots to states two and five; the name and domain do not infer an effect identity beyond that local behavior.
Recovered only from retained owner assembly, approved local GS1 ROMs, local callers and effect-slot types, and the approved compiler. No GS2 evidence or external game source was used.
